variants.prompt: A striking young woman with rich chestnut hair swept into an effortless updo, bright emerald eyes glowing under neon club lighting, leans against a sleek, black pole in a pulsing dance club. Her smooth porcelain skin glistens under the strobing lights. She exudes confidence in a barely-there bikini, the iridescent fabric clinging to her curves, paired with glittering thigh-high boots and a statement silver necklace. Neon hues dance across her skin as she moves to the throbbing beat.
